title: Prime Time Charters

services.name: Fishing Reports
services.desc: Today was the traditional friend and family day for striped bass. Us 4 loaded the boat and headed to the main stem of the bay where the striped bass was migrating. With only a half day in mind we put the tackle and and new boat to the test. The boat performed extremely well and we managed to boat a 32" and a 40" trophy striped bass in the in adverse conditions. David managed a you tube video and well as a few photos to start the season. Thank you Henry, David and Clayton for making this a successful trip. Today a party of 12 was split between 2 boats. 6 anglers boarded and we went south west to the fishing grounds. the action recently has been hit or miss so we put forth the effort to try
